hint: Cosecant is the reciprocal of sine — flip the fraction.

hints.text: Cosecant is the reciprocal of sine — flip the fraction.
The reciprocal of $-\frac{1}{3}$ keeps the negative sign.

explanation: Flipping $-\frac{1}{3}$ gives $-3$; a reciprocal never changes the sign.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why cosecant is never small
steps: Sine always sits between $-1$ and $1$, so its reciprocal is always at least $1$ away from zero.
Here sine is only $\frac{1}{3}$ in size, so cosecant is $3$ in size — the smaller the sine, the more extreme the cosecant.
